name: Shinonome
source:
An executive in the “Umon-kai” Yakuza syndicate.

In charge of the Umon-kai’s criminal dealings, he is [url=/c133543/]Tatsuya[/url]'s direct boss.
Unerringly obedient to the orders of syndicate boss [url=/c135884/]Gorou[/url], he is exceptionally sharp-witted.

[From [url=https://www.kaguragames.com/product/criminal-border-2nd-offence/]Kagura Games[/url]]
